body: 设计一张移动应用首页视觉稿，应用名“周末鲜集”。顶部显示日期与地点，主体有搜索栏、蔬果与烘焙分类、两张摊主卡片以及营业时间，底部四个清晰导航入口。中文可读，白色背景，叶绿色重点色，留白充足，真实食材缩略图。只展示平面界面，不放手机外壳，不伪装为已运行的应用。

en.title: Farmers market mobile interface
en.description: Chinese farmers market UI includes search, produce and bakery cards, two merchant cards, opening hours and four navigation icons
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Chinese farmers market UI includes search, produce and bakery cards, two merchant cards, opening hours and four navigation icons. This is a visual mockup, not a functioning app.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#create-an-interface-preview). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

## 使用方法

使用本次实际提交的提示词，无需参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

中文农贸市场界面包含搜索、蔬果与烘焙分类、两张摊主卡片、营业时间和四个底部入口。这是界面效果图，不是可操作的应用。

## 来源与生成

来源公开原提示词；本次使用单独记录的制作提示词。[来源](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#create-an-interface-preview)。来源帖互动数不代表本次新生成案例的热度。

本例使用内置 GPT Image 工具生成。工具未返回精确模型 ID；GPT Image 2.6 是调研主题，不作为本次输出的已验证版本声明。使用的参考图均为本项目新生成。
